explanatory_first_jet_pencil.identity: -5 H_I4 grad P + 3 H_P grad I4 - 15 I2 grad P + 45 P grad I2 = 0
explanatory_first_jet_pencil.potential: a I2^3 + b I2 I4 + d I6
proof: Direct symbolic differentiation gives the coefficient matrix in the seven independent Cartan covector monomials.
The displayed nonzero parameter minor proves generic rank four. The exact fixed kernel and nonzero three-by-three minor prove fixed rank three.

Equivariance and regular-semisimple density extend the identity to the full adjoint representation. Pairing with the first jet and using the Euler identity for P gives an original Jacobian-jet syzygy.
explanatory_first_jet_pencil.scope: Exact selected quartic singlet-pencil drop. First full generic-Schur discrepancy and jump-plus-two remain unverified.

polynomial_basis: I2^2 times product of x_j for j != i
I4 times product of x_j for j != i
next_pfaffian_strand.potential: a I2^3 + b I2 I4 + d I6
proof: Symbolic Hessian-gradient contraction gives the displayed two-source coefficient matrix.
The nonzero generic minor proves rank two; the fixed kernel and nonzero entry prove rank one.
Equivariance and regular-semisimple density extend the Cartan identity to the full adjoint. Pairing with the first jet gives the original Jacobian-jet syzygy.
next_pfaffian_strand.scope: Selected Pfaffian strand at q10, after the selected quartic strand at q9. Full Hilbert differences and the first full jump remain unverified.

jump_verification.scope: Exact coefficient-sensitive rank drop at base8/jet1 from complete QQ image sectors, with fixed and rational-probe full series through q9. Earlier Schur coefficients agree through q8. The rational probe does not establish a parameter-function-field generic Hilbert-series theorem. Required full Macdonald/Schur/HL window remains q11.

notes: Syzygy jump detected: q^9, base/jet [8, 1]. Jump + 2 target: q^11; current QQ Macdonald: q^9 inclusive.
The character formula applies to the KLS candidate through the first null only. Higher flavor decompositions are not inferred from unrefined dimensions.
